explanation: The statement is that two HeckeCosets of the library's own HeckePair are equal when their toSet images are equal. Both HeckeCoset (an abbrev for Quotient (dcSetoid P)) and toSet are library definitions. Mathlib has a different HeckeCoset in Mathlib/NumberTheory/HeckeRing/Defs.lean, parametrised by Δ H₁ H₂. That file has no toSet and no ext-by-set lemma, and it has no HeckePair. I found no Mathlib declaration with this content. The proof is just Quotient.sound, and the content lies in the library's own definitions.
